strings.en: Same as ever, huh, Captain Bright.
Yes... First the last war, and now this...
I'd like to get some rest for once. At any rate, good work, Elle.
Don't mention it, Bright. I've gotta work hard for Judau and Roux too.
Judau and Roux... That's right, after the fight with the Titans ended...
they set off for the Jupiter Sphere, didn't they?
...Judau... You mean the ZZ Gundam pilot?
Yes. He was a gifted Newtype. A problem child too, though.
They left Earth far behind for Jupiter... and boarded the Jovian
resource fleet ship Jupitris II.
Jupiter... The gravity well that gave birth to Paptimus Scirocco.
What was he looking for there?
I don't know. ...But they're the ones who'll carry the coming era.
That's exactly why we have to protect the present one.
Heavy stuff...
But why did you end up bringing us a Gundam prototype, Elle...
Unit 4, wasn't it?
Hm? Oh, it's the same as with the Titans.
Why can't those Federation bigwigs ever act right away?
They end up relying on Londo Bell in the end anyway.
That's the military for you. ...That's all I can say.
Seriously. Even the Gerbera I brought...
Nina at Anaheim arranged to send it to Londo Bell, you know?
The developers are working hard, so what's the actual military doing?
...Jaburo HQ has gone silent.
With mysterious invaders swarming all over the Earth Sphere...
acting on our own would undermine military discipline.
Which is exactly why we, as an independent unit... right?
You were like that back with the Argama too, Captain.
Don't blame me if you get an ulcer, okay?
They say men your age are most at risk, Captain? Better be careful.
Captain.
Hm... Ahem. Captain Quattro. What is it?
Yes. We've received word from Side 7.
Side 7... Green Oasis, the former Titans headquarters?
Now? What is it?
It's from Captain South Burning. He volunteered himself as a replacement.
He's headed our way with one mobile suit.
If only he'd bring, like, ten super robots like Grendizer.
The super robots that fought in the last war... are now mothballed
or missing. The only one in military hands is the Cyber Beast Force's...
Dancougar, and even it hasn't had any proper tuning.
Still, just one~? Can you even call that reinforcements?
It can't be helped. One mobile suit can't turn the tide of battle,
but having that one opens up options. We must think positively.
For now, all we can do is build up our forces bit by bit...
Oh, speaking of reinforcements, what happened with the talk of
having the Cyber Beast Force sent over to us, Captain?
Right, let's check on that. Open a channel...
Hm? From the surface? Open the channel!
Oh, well, well.
Whoa, Commander Hazuki, your face got wider!?
No, that's someone else. ...You're from the Mars Frontier Base...
A pleasure to meet you, Colonel Bright, formerly of the Argama.
I am Hazard of the Mars Frontier Base. Hazard Pasha.
The Mars Frontier Base...? I'm Colonel Bright Noa of the
Earth Federation Forces independent unit Londo Bell. What do you need?
Well, you're aware that a mysterious battleship has descended to Earth?
...!! We fought that mysterious battleship just moments ago.
We failed to stop its descent to Earth, though...
I thought so... Now, you're aware that my Mars Frontier Base
is under attack by aliens, yes?
Yes, the alien army called the Za Boom Army... correct?
Precisely! My, it gave me quite a chill.
We've somehow repelled them every time, but...
now they've turned to Earth, you see. Yes.
Then the crane-shaped battleship that descended to Earth is...!
Exactly. ...I haven't seen it myself, mind you,
but we intercepted their messages... They appear to have sent
an invasion weapon called the Elshank to Earth.
An invasion weapon... The Za Boom Army...!?
As one who loves the Earth, I simply cannot allow
such a thing, no matter what...
And so I took the liberty of contacting all of you in Londo Bell.
Thank you. We appreciate your efforts.
Not at all. Londo Bell, gathering of battle-hardened heroes that you are...
I'm sure you'll destroy that devilish weapon.
...Well, I'll be going now...
Commander Hazard, may I ask one thing?
Hm? What is it?
It's a trivial matter, but... why did you call the invasion weapon
"Elshank," which you've never seen... a battleship?
O-oh? Wasn't it Captain Bright who called it that?
No. Also... I hear you're under attack by unmanned units of unknown origin.
...Is that so?
J-just what do you suspect? My Mars Frontier Base won't simply...
Hahaha! W-well then, Captain Bright, I'm counting on you.
He hung up in a hurry.
Captain Quattro, why did you ask him that?
Well, I don't hear many good rumors about the Mars Frontier Base.
He seems to be hiding something...
The Mars Frontier Base... The Meganoids' old forward base?
Unmanned weapons of unknown origin... You mean the Jovian Lizards.
Yes... Anyway, we'll contact the Gandor Team's Commander Hazuki
at the Far East Branch and confirm the situation.
I knew it... This movable frame... And the joint mechanisms... This is...!
Is that... Hey, Lieutenant Uraki.
But... No, I'm sure of it. This armor... It's clearly...
Lieutenant Uraki, got a minute?
Huh... Ah! Umon? ...Sorry, I was lost in thought.
No, you just looked so serious, so I was curious.
This is the robot Elle brought, right? ...Is it a Neo Zeon machine?
No... This is probably... no, definitely a Gundam...!
Huh? Come on, all Gundams look the same to me,
but I wouldn't mistake this one for one.
That's the thing. Gundams share similar mechanisms,
so they basically end up looking alike... But this one hides that.
Why? ...It looks like a Zeon machine no matter how you look at it...
It's definitely Zeonic technology.
The problem is... why was it being built at Anaheim?
Then, don't tell me...
What's this? Short-handed, sure, but nobody to greet me?
Huh! Captain Burning!? When did you get here!?
Just now. As of today, I'm assigned to Londo Bell.
I heard greenhorns like you are having to go to the front lines.
I couldn't very well sit around in a colony.
Captain South Burning, I presume. I'm Daisuke Umon.
Shorthanded as we are... thank you.
So you're Umon. From another star system... Hmm, you look Earthling.
I'd like Earthlings to handle the Earth Sphere's problems ourselves...
but it seems we can't afford that. Glad to have you aboard.
Yes, likewise.
Your unit's a GM... Custom type? Where'd you dig that up?
It's been tuned. I had Nina Purpleton put in a word for me.
Nina did? I see...
(As I thought. Official channels mean Federation mass-production units.
...A Gerbera Tetra... Why'd it come through Anaheim's back channels...?)
...Because we in Londo Bell couldn't hold them back...
we let Gaizok descend to Earth. I'm sorry...
No, it couldn't be helped in this situation, Captain Bright.
The Elshank, the ship that attacked the Mars Frontier Base,
is also heading for the surface.
The base was attacked? What is this Elshank...?
Commander Hazard of the Mars Frontier Base said it was a scout
for new invaders, the Za Boom Army, but...
But...?
It never attacked us,
and it looked like it was being chased by the Za Boom Army.
Also, the base commander, Hazard Pasha...
seems to be hiding something.
I see... the Za Boom Army. We'll stay on guard here too.
Still, it's worrying. Mars...
Even though the Jovian Lizards have appeared on Mars,
Commander Hazard said there was no need to worry about Mars...
I see... Mars's forces can hardly be called sufficient, though...
Perhaps they're lucky that the unmanned Jovian Lizards
aren't all that powerful.
Or... is there some reason it'd be bad for us to come to Mars...
Yes. Either way, it needs investigating.
By the way, how are things on the surface?
Those Jovian Lizards, in fact, appeared in Sasebo.
Sasebo!? Isn't that where...
Yes, where the Nadesico's hangar was.
The Nadesico... Nergal's mobile battleship, built in secret...
When we reached Sasebo, the Jovian Lizards were fighting the Nadesico.
It's hard to believe the Jovian Lizards showed up in Sasebo by chance.
Yes... They were most likely after the Nadesico...
Though it does bother me that a Gaizok battleship appeared
after our Gandor Team arrived in Sasebo...
Are you saying the Jovian Lizards were Gaizok machines?
...The Jin family said they probably were...
but it's only a possibility. We can't be certain.
I feel the Jovian Lizards belong to some other organization entirely.
True, it's dangerous to simply link Gaizok and the Jovian Lizards.
Yes...
Where is the Nadesico now?
The Nadesico got away from us in Sasebo.
I see... But we can roughly guess.
Yes... Most likely to Mars.
So it's begun? ...The Scaparelli Project...
And about the Nadesico's captain...
Hm? A transmission...
Hm... Ahem! Captains of the Gandor Team and Londo Bell...
is the signal coming through clearly?
Admiral... Admiral Misumaru? You're safe!?
Well, I'm off. ...Ulube, await the good news.
Yes. I trust you'll live up to the School of the Undefeated East.
Ulube! You understand, don't you...
When this mission is successfully done...!
Calm down, Domon! It can't be helped. We have to chase "that thing"!
I don't lie, Domon Kasshu.
...There's room for leniency regarding your father's crime as well.
Shut up! My father committed no crime!
If there's any crime... it's Kyoji's crime!
Domon...
That's enough! ...What you should be doing now
is not howling, Domon.
...Yes, Master.
Then I wish you luck. ...Oh yes, "that thing"... the Ultimate Gundam...
after breaking out of the research facility, somehow changed its makeup,
and reportedly turned into an entirely different Mobile Fighter.
Entirely different...? What's that supposed to mean?
That much, I don't know.
...Besides capturing it, I'd appreciate it if you'd look into that.
Hmph. I won't ask what you're scheming. But I'll remember it.
Let's go, Domon, Allenby!
Yes, Master!
Let's wrap this up quick! ...Huh? Where's Rain?
Rain went ahead to Earth. ...I asked her to look into something.
(...Mr. Mikamura...? Why is he here...?)
That girl, eh? Very well.
From here, we should catch it before it lands on Earth.
Let's have the girl do some sightseeing on Earth, eh, Domon?
Yes, I won't let it reach Earth! Sorry, Rain, but...
Yeah. We'll get Rain some souvenirs from Earth...
...Though there's hardly anything worth seeing on Earth now...
...Master...?
Then I leave it in your hands.
...With Jaburo out of contact... if that thing reaches the surface,
we won't be able to back you up from here... Please don't forget that.
Understood. ...I'll settle this quickly...!
Admiral... So Jaburo really has...
Yes. Not something I like to think about, but...
Understood. We'll investigate Jaburo.
Good. I'm counting on you.
By the way, Admiral, are you aware that the Nadesico...
Nergal's mobile battleship, has left Sasebo?
Yuuurikaaa! Why, oh why did you leave your daddy behind!?
Captain Bright... the Nadesico's captain is the Admiral's daughter.
The Admiral's...!? I-I see... So she's the Nadesico's captain...
That's right! Yurikaaa, please come home!
A-Admiral...
Hm!? ...Ahem! ...When it comes to my daughter, I lose my composure.
My apologies. Harrumph.
N-No, that's just how fathers are...
Isn't it, though!? Bright, my boy, you must cherish your wife and kids...
Um... May we get back on topic? ...Admiral?
Oh, right you are.
As you all know, the Scaparelli Project is underway.
And my beloved Yurika is aboard the Nadesico as its captain.
Nergal's manager said it was all settled with the Federation, but...
...To tell the truth, I don't know the details either.
It seems the heads of the Federation and Nergal
worked it out between themselves while I was away.
I see...
But what kind of deal with Nergal can't be shared with an admiral...?
Indeed. And with Jaburo as it is, there's no way to confirm it.
...But it's clear the Nadesico is no enemy.
Meaning...?
Why, Yurika is its captain, after all! Wa ha ha ha ha!
Urk... C-certainly, your daughter can be trusted, but...
the problem is Nergal.
I can't believe the Scaparelli Project's goal
stops at simply retaking Mars.
Hmm. That concerns me as well...
But for now, the Nadesico is a valuable asset, military or not.
Yes, that's true.
What is your view, Admiral Misumaru?
Should we really let the Nadesico go on to Mars like this?
Mars's forces are especially thin.
If the Nadesico goes there, it'll surely help Commander Hazard...
Admiral. About this Commander Hazard...
Hazard Pasha, the commander of the Mars Frontier Base...
Hmm. I see... That is suspicious...
But if the Nadesico heads to Mars, something is bound to happen.
Please pass that along to Yurika as well.
Understood, Admiral.
Then I wish you all the best of luck.
So we still don't know what's going on at Jaburo...
Still, it's a relief to hear that Admiral Misumaru and other Federation
forces are dealing with enemies around the world.
Yes. If we can track down the Nadesico, we'll try to make contact.
Please do. ...We'll arrive at the Space Science Laboratory shortly.
I'll send either Kabuto or Tsurugi to you.
When things are so bad on the surface too...
I don't know what to say, making you split your forces like this...
No, we'll manage somehow. Whatever the case, with that many
organizations on the move, the more strength you have, the better...
We can't rely on a helper who may or may not show up... Please.
Still, how intriguing. A hero standing atop your bridge, you say?
I almost wish we had one here, too.
Nothing makes any sense. ...It's enough to drive me mad.
If that "works out," it may be a stroke of luck. ...Farewell.
Yes. Good luck to you.
Whew...
You look tired, Captain.
A hero, huh. Shouldn't you have told him more about it?
Yes. ...But a champion of justice who appeared on top of the bridge...
What do you think Commander Hazuki would make of that?
"The captain's worn out." ...Something like that.
Which is true, though.
What are you talking about? A champion of justice...?
...Ahem. In any case, we can't give the Gandor Team needless worries.
The return of Dr. Hell, who once preached world domination...
A lot seems to be happening on the surface too... What's going on?
Captain, earlier you said something about the Mazinger team...?
That. Yes, Prof. Yumi in Japan foresaw the invaders' return,
and apparently kept Mazinger Z and Great Mazinger
ready to go at any time.
Huh!? Then...
They're sending Mazinger Z, Dianan A, and Boss Borot
to us, along with the Cyber Beast Force.
Koji!? I'll finally get to see him again?
Mazinger Z... Koji.
Sayaka's unit has a repair device, and Boss's has a resupply device.
So we're getting a bunch more super robots? Wow, what a help!
Still, I hear the surface is in chaos too.
Is it really all right to divide their forces like that?
It's fine. The surface has Tetsuya... the Great Hero, Great Mazinger.
He'd never lose to the underground people.
They're sending Great Mazinger, Venus A, and Boss Borot
to us, along with the Cyber Beast Force.
Tetsuya is?
Great Mazinger... Tetsuya.
Jun's unit has a repair device, and Boss's has a resupply device.
So we're getting a bunch more super robots? Wow, what a help!
Still, I hear the surface is in chaos too.
Is it really all right to divide their forces like that?
It's fine. The surface has Koji... the Castle of Iron, Mazinger Z.
He'd never lose to the underground people.
You trust him.
Yes.
(I'd like to believe in him too... But can he escape the gravity well?)
We'll be leaving the atmosphere shortly.
Now straight on to Mars... Huh? Prospector?
Eh? Oh, uh, I was just wondering what became of the Gandor Team.
I feel we did them rather wrong.
The Gandor Team had no casualties. With Mazinger Z, Getter Robo...
all that firepower gathered, I doubt they'd easily lose.
Yeah, they were strong, just like Gekiganger.
Hmph, if my Aestivalis hadn't been poorly maintained,
it would've been a piece of cake!
Poorly maintained!? Hey, Yamada! Get over here!
What!? I'm Daigoji...
Ow ow ow! Quit pullin' me!
Yamada, exit stage left~
Hmm, true, Great Mazinger, the crescent robot that came later,
and... the Super Beast Machine God that faced down Muge Zorbados...
They leave nothing to be desired, but...
They were all so colorful and amazing! And the arms flew off,
and beams came out of the stomach...
I wish some of them would help us out...
That's not it, Tenkawa.
Those super robots are almost all privately owned.
Privately owned...? What does that mean?
For times like this, here you go, Ruri-Ruri.
The humanoid weapons called super robots were mostly
built at robot research institutes in Japan.
Mazinger Z: Prof. Gennosuke Yumi's Photon Power Laboratory.
Great Mazinger, Mazinger Z's upgraded model:
Dr. Kenzo Kabuto's Science Fortress Laboratory. Getter Robo is a
Saotome Laboratory test robot, under Getter Ray expert Dr. Saotome,
and wasn't originally meant for combat.
(But it carries something like an axe...)
Seems more than enough to me.
In terms of combat power, yes.
What concerns me are a certain company's rather distasteful robots...
A certain company...?
You mean... Anaheim Electronics?
Well... yes, but their models seem rather outdated...
I can never tell Gundams apart...
But the one with blue covers on its hands is the Federation's White Devil?
Speaking of old, isn't the Federation's White Devil... the Gundam old too?
Hmm, that's not quite it... Is it, Hoshino?
The hornless Gundam is the RX-79(G) Ez-8, "Easy Eight."
It belongs to the Far East Army's 08th MS Team.
And the one Minato called the White Devil
is its successor, the RX-78-NT1... codenamed Alex.
Well, it's a Gundam, anyway.
Hornless Gundams are so cute, aren't they?
No, that's not the point here.
...I see. Plus there's that Zeon Zaku. Yeah, that's old...
And the bulky red one, if I recall, is a Gespenst...
A famous model, called Mao Industries' masterpiece Personal Trooper,
but the Gespenst series itself is already out of production.
I had Omoikane look it up. That's the PTX-003C... codename
Alteisen.
It's a custom unit of that series, but there's no record of any built after it.
In other words, it was either a cost problem or a defective unit.
...And that's how it is, everyone.
In this situation, that's about all the pieces the Federation has to play.
Their newest is the Metas... and even that's from the Gryps Conflict...
Their HQ is definitely not functioning...
Then getting to Mars'll be a breeze! Yay, lucky us!
Sigh...
Idiot.
